"During your action phase, ILLUSIONIST AURAS YOU CONTROL ARE WEAPONS with 1 base {p} and 'Once per Turn Action - 0: Attack'. If there is a yellow card in your pitch zone, your Illusionist attacks get go again."

Clause 1 changes what OTHER permanents ARE, which needed three things at once: a base {p} an aura has no printed field for, an activated attack that ACTION GENERATION will offer, and both of them stopping when the condition stops. It had been MODIFY_ATTACK_POWER_PER_UNIQUE_AURA mod:"set" amount:1 -- an effect that COUNTS distinct aura names in the arena, not a type change -- on a plain STATIC, which nothing dispatches, gated on CONTROLS_TOKEN_TYPE "Illusionist", which is not a token type. GRANT_ATTACK_WHILE is declarative and re-derived on every legality pass, for the same reason the conditional freeze is: "during your action phase" is true and false repeatedly within a turn, and a one-shot grant would leave the auras permanently armed. The per-turn allowance is initialised only when a permanent NEWLY enters the grant, so re-deriving mid-turn does not hand back an attack that was already used.

Clause 2 was also a plain STATIC, and its gate was REF_PITCH_IS color:"yellow" -- which tests a card a previous effect STORED, and no effect on this card stores one -- rather than the contents of the pitch zone. As a WHILE_STATIC on RECALC_ATTACK_POWER the grant reaches the live combat, which is where GAIN keyword puts it.
